run: backpropagation on the Two-Franks stitch, sponsor's full schedule
sponsor_direction: Roman, 2026-11-26 09:07 EST: 'Your full schedule: seams first, backbone in once below 6.90%'

surrogate.kind: anchored expected tour length (bert_attribution.soft_forward structure): the network's own greedy picks held constant; at each visited state the pointer distribution at temperature tau prices the expected next leg
surrogate.note: measured on the fixed validation set for this subject before training; the run proceeded regardless of the value

training.optimizer: hand-rolled Adam, bias-corrected, one global step counter
training.batch_stream: 64 fresh problems per step, n = 10 cities, uniform on the unit square, numpy default_rng seed 20261202; never the validation problems
training.picks: each step's batch picks are the current weights' own greedy picks (numpy decode), held constant inside that step's gradient
training.gradient_masking: a gene with multiplier 0 also receives zero gradient, so its Adam moments stay at zero and its value is bit-identical while frozen
training.objective: mean anchored soft tour length over the batch (raw lengths, not gaps: fresh problems have no optima computed)

schedule.trigger: true validation gap < 6.8959% at a read (reads every 100 steps)
schedule.phase1: stitching genes only; stop the whole run if no trigger after 1500 steps
